title: Salt and Sunshine
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gulf Front Gated Private Property - Gulf Front Infinity Edge Pool (pool can be heated for an additional $100 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) - Direct Private beach access - Elevator - 6 Bikes & 6-seater Golf Cart Included Escape to an extraordinary Gulf-front estate in Santa Rosa Beach, where breathtaking views, timeless architecture, and refined coastal luxury create an unforgettable vacation experience. This newly constructed five-bedroom retreat, designed by acclaimed architect Geoff Chick, offers an exceptional blend of elegance, comfort, and privacy. A private gated entrance welcomes you to a stunning outdoor oasis featuring an infinity-edge pool that seamlessly blends into the Gulf horizon, a fully equipped outdoor kitchen, and thoughtfully designed sea turtle-friendly landscape lighting. Inside, expansive windows and multiple porches showcase panoramic views of the Gulf from nearly every room, while the home's eastern and northern exposures overlook one of 30A's rare and beautiful coastal dune lakes. Natural light fills every space, creating a seamless connection between the indoors and the surrounding coastal beauty. The open-concept main living area is designed for gathering, while the upper levels offer peaceful sitting areas and covered porches perfect for morning coffee, evening sunsets, or simply unwinding with the sound of the waves. A built-in sound system extends throughout the main living spaces and outdoor porches, enhancing every moment of your stay. Whether you're planning a relaxing family escape or an unforgettable beachfront getaway with friends, this exceptional coastal sanctuary offers luxury, privacy, and some of the most spectacular views along Florida's Emerald Coast. Sleeping Arrangements Second Floor - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom w/ Shower Only Third Floor - Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, w/ Shower & Soaking Tub - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Combo - Half Bathroom Fourth Floor - Bunkroom w/ 3 XL Twin Bunks w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - Half Bathroom
